blocks.text: INDIAN WELLS, California — It’ll be rising teenager Mirra Andreeva against veteran Elina Svitolina in the WTA Finals title match, with Andreeva making her first appearance and Svitolina her third overall after a gap of seven years. Andreeva is the first teen since 2004 to compete for the title after defeating American Jessica Pegula 6-3, 6-4 in the semifinals on Saturday. The 19-year-old Russian is having quite a year, winning her first Grand Slam title at the French Open and rising to No. 2 in the world.
